brief:
Jewish settlers forced the family of Basher Naeem Koona to evacuate their house in al-Taybeh village, east of Ramallah, just one week after moving in, according to Shehab Wire. The family abandoned the residence following a sustained campaign of attacks and threats by settlers in the area.

Koona documented the expulsion in a video statement, recounting the circumstances that compelled his family to leave their newly occupied home. The incident marks another displacement of Palestinian civilians from properties in the West Bank village, as settler pressure continues to reshape communities east of Ramallah.
